description: This file defines an abstract class 'ValueTypeSerializer' and a generic implementation 'ValueTypeSerializer<T>' for serializing value types that implement ISerializable. It includes methods for writing and reading serialized data, handling callbacks, and managing serialization info.

classes.name: ValueTypeSerializer
classes.description: An abstract base class for serializing value types.

classes.name: ValueTypeSerializer<T>
classes.description: A generic serializer for value types implementing ISerializable, providing methods for writing and reading serialized data, with support for callbacks and custom constructors.

methods.name: WriteValue
methods.description: Serializes a value of type T using the provided writer, invoking callbacks and handling serialization info.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes data from the reader into a value of type T, invoking callbacks and reconstructing the object.

methods.name: ValueTypeSerializer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the serializer with callbacks, constructor delegate, entry serializer, streaming context, and formatter converter.
